sight.t: Above the roofs, stars, and the dark shape of the hills.
Beyond the window, nothing but the dark.

sound.t: Somewhere a watchman calls the hour.
A dog barks a long way off.
The quiet of the small hours.
A train, or a truck, far off and going away.

touch.t: The cold of the night has got in.

sight.t: Grey light, coming slowly.
The sky pales in the east.

sound.t: A bell for the first office.

touch.t: The coldest hour, just before the sun.

sight.t: Daylight, flat and plain.
Daylight through the shutters, in thin bars.

sound.t: The ordinary noise of people at work.

touch.t: The sun has some warmth in it.

sight.t: The last red light on the roofs.
Lamps coming on, one by one.

touch.t: The air cools quickly as the light goes.

sight.t: The sky is clear and hard.
A clear night; every star is out.

touch.t: A clear sky, and a frost coming.

sight.t: Cloud, low and moving.

touch.t: A fitful wind under the cloud.

sight.t: Rain, steady and grey, blurring everything past a few yards.
Rain runs down the window.

touch.t: Rain, cold, getting in at the collar.
The damp of the rain has come indoors.

sight.t: Fog, or rain so heavy it might as well be.
Lightning, and for an instant everything shows.

touch.t: The wind shoves and pulls; rain stings the face.
The walls shake in the gusts.

sight.t: A full moon throws hard shadows.
A swollen moon, bright enough to see by.
A half moon, and grey light enough to make out shapes.
A thin moon that gives almost no light.
No moon tonight; the dark is complete.
Garlands on the doors for {{feast}}.
The streets are empty: curfew.

sound.t: Nobody about; only the watch, far off.

sight.t: A torch burns, smoky and orange.
Candles, their flames bending in the draught.
A lantern throws a ring of light.
A lamp burns, turned low.
Electric light, hard and even.

sound.t: The faint buzz of the bulb.

sight.t: Fire, burning hot and bright.

sound.t: The roar and crack of the fire.

touch.t: The heat of the fire beats against the skin.

sight.t: A brazier full of coals.
Something glitters on the floor: broken glass, or worse.

sound.t: A thin electric hum, and a smell of hot wire.
Sound comes through the open doorway.

touch.t: A draught from the open door.

sight.t: A door hangs off its hinges, the frame splintered.

sound.t: Someone breathing, slow and careful, very close.

smell.t: A trace of sweat and fear where nobody should be.

sight.t: Something about the ground here looks wrong.
{{name}} catches the eye; it would bear a closer look.
In sight: {{people}}.

sound.t: A small sound not long ago, {{dir}}: a scrape, a click.
Talk and the knock of cups {{dir}}.
Someone waiting {{dir}}, shifting from foot to foot.

sight.t: The world seen through deep water: the same shapes, softer, and lit from nowhere.
Things here look as they are felt, not as they are built.
Small spirits drift at the edges of sight and are gone when looked at.

sound.t: The physical world is muffled, a sound in another room.

smell.t: The air tastes of the place's mood.

touch.t: The Gauntlet's pressure at the back of the head.

sight.t: Everything grows and shifts: plants that weren't there a moment ago, colours that won't settle.
Straight lines everywhere, and fine webs strung over every edge and corner.

sound.t: A faint clicking, like a great many small legs.

sight.t: Black slime in the corners, and shadows that lean toward the living.

smell.t: Rot and oil and something burnt.

sight.t: A still place; even the spirits here are sleeping.
The church glows faintly from within, or stands hollow and cold, as its faith is.
The walls are thick with fear, layered like soot.
The caern blazes; the spirits here are many and awake.

sound.t: Voices in no language, all around.

sight.t: Old quarrels hang in the air like smoke.
Want and greed, worn into the stones by a thousand bargains.
The trees stand tall and aware; some of them watch.
The street's reflection is narrow and furtive, all doorways.
Small comforts and old griefs, faint as breath on glass.
Everything is grey, cracked and worn, as it will look when it has fallen down.
The living go by as warm, bright shapes.
Chains of rust on a door; letters on a wall that faded long ago.

sound.t: The Skinlands come through thin and far away.
Someone weeping, somewhere close and not of this side.

smell.t: Dust and ash and the end of things.

touch.t: The Shroud is a pressure, close against the face.
A pull, faint, toward something that matters.

sight.t: Graves under the floor show as dark wells; some are not empty.
The place is deep in decay, as if it died long before its owner.
Old deaths here have left their marks like water stains.
The tavern is half fallen in, its tables rotted, its fire cold ash.
The trees are grey bones; the fields lie under ash.
Blood on the stones that no one living can see, from wars long over.

any.t: The hairs rise on the neck: something not natural is close, {{dir}}.

kindred.t: Wyrm-taint, the stale cold of the walking dead, {{dir}}.

place.t: The place itself is fouled; the Wyrm has been at work here.

lupine.t: Wolf-blood, {{dir}}: one of the Garou, or their kin.

kindred.t: A dead thing wearing a living scent, {{dir}}.

fae.t: Flowers, cold iron and something older, {{dir}}.

mage.t: A human scent with lightning in it, {{dir}}.

any.t: Something not human and not animal, {{dir}}.
Not everyone here is what they look like: {{count}} {{dir}}.

living.t: Life, all around: {{count}} warm, beating hearts within reach of the senses.

kindred.t: And one heart, {{dir}}, that does not beat at all.

spirit.t: Spirits gather {{dir}}; the Gauntlet is thin there.

place.t: The Gauntlet here feels {thin as gauze|thick as a wall}.

any.t: Decay in everything: the wood half rotten, the iron eaten through in places.

kindred.t: Something {{dir}} carries death in it, held back but certain.

mage.t: Quintessence stirs {{dir}}: someone here works magic.

place.t: The place is rich with raw Quintessence.

fae.t: Glamour {{dir}}: a kithain, and their true seeming plain to see.

place.t: Chimerical things here: {a door that isn't there by day|flowers growing out of the stone|a small creature watching}.

living.t: The living burn bright: {{count}} of them {{dir}}.

hurt.t: One of them is hurt; the decay shows like a bruise on the light.
